text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

AUSTRALIA, June 3 - COAL - QUEENSLAND - Abbot Point - berth vacant. 5 vessels due by 26/6 no delays. Hay Point - maintenance shutdown on berth 1 from 29/5-9/6 and berth 2 from 10/6-8/7. One vessel loading, 2 waiting, 4 due by 24/6, no delays. Dalrymple Bay - maintenance shutdown p.m. 2/6 to p.m. 5/6. One vessel loading, 16 due by 22/6. No delays.

Gladstone - Union members at Curragh Mine extended stoppage for a further 2 weeks from 23/5 over EBA issues. R.G. Tanna - berth vacant, 21 vessels due by 25/7, no delays. Barney Point, one vessel loading, 4 vessels due by 23/7, no delays. Brisbane - one vessel loading, 3 due by 16/6, no delays.

NEW SOUTH WALES - Newcastle - Kooragang, 2 vessels loading, 14 waiting, 17 due by 18/6, 8-10 days delay. Dyke 4+5, 2 vessels loading, 10 waiting, 17 vessels due by 19/6, 13-15 days delay. Port Kembla - berth vacant, 22 vessels due by 25/8, no delays.

IRON ORE - Western Australia - Port Kembla - Mt. Newman (Nelson Point), due to occasional shortage of lump and fines and yandi fines, iron ore vessels may experience delays to berthing/loading or be forced to berth out of turn. Changes to state industrial legislation means rolling strikes may occur. Stoppages are not anticipated to cause delays to berthing/loading of iron ore vessels. Berth A - 1 vessel loading, 3 anchored. Berth B - 3 vessels anchored 6 others anchored, 11 due by 10/6, 3 other vessels due with no eta.

Goldsworthy (Finucane Island) - 2 vessels due by 8/6. Dampier - Parker Point 1 vessel loading, 6 anchored. E.I. Island - 1 vessel loading, 5 anchored, 24 due by 23/6. Port Walcott - one vessel loading, 8 due by 20/6.

June 4 - GRAIN - Queensland - Mackay - no vessels due. Gladstone - two vessels due. Holiday 9 June. Labour available at holiday rates. Brisbane - one wheat vessel in port, 2 wheat vessels due by 7/6. Holiday 9 June. Labour available at holiday rates.

NEW SOUTH WALES - Newcastle - one vessel loading wheat, 3 wheat vessels due by 18/6. Holiday 9 June. No labour available. Sydney - no further grain loading expected at this port. Port Kembla - one vessel loading wheat, 7 vessels due by 24/6. Berthing programme based on grade of cargo receivals by rail. Plant maintenance from 3/6 to 5/6. Public holiday 9 June. Labour available at holiday rates. Victoria - Geelong - one vessel loading wheat, 1 rice vessel in port, 2 wheat vessels due by 17/6. Holiday 9 June. No labour available. Portland - one vessel loading wheat, 6 vessels due by 5/7. Holiday 9 June. Labour available at holiday rates.

SOUTH AUSTRALIA - Port Pirie - no vessels due. Port Adelaide - one wheat vessel in port. Thevenard - one vessel loading barley. Port Lincoln - one wheat vessel due 6/6. Wallaroo - no vessels due. Ardrossan - no vessels due. Port Giles - no vessels due. Holiday 9 June in all South Australian ports. Labour available at ordinary holiday rates.

WESTERN AUSTRALIA - Geraldton - one vessel loading feed, 5 vessels due by 22/6. Kwinana - one vessel loading wheat, 2 wheat vessels in port, 6 vessels due by 24/6. Albany - five vessels due by 14/6. Esperance - one vessel loading wheat, 1 barley vessel due 6/6. The June 9 holiday is not applicable in Western Australian ports.
